RENT AGREEMENT
This Agreement is made on 3 August 2026 between Meena Nair (Landlord) and Sunita Kumar (Tenant).
1. The Landlord lets the flat at 79, Temple Road, Coimbatore - 641001 for 11 months from 1 September 2026.
2. Rent is Rs. 25,000 per month, due by the 5th of each month.
3. Security deposit is Rs. 75,000, refundable on vacating.
4. Either party may end the tenancy on one month's notice.
5. The courts at Pune have jurisdiction.
